text:
jordan: Heads-up — scheduling a blue->green stepped tilt for router service (router-v3) during the 02:00 UTC change window. Planning steps: 10% / 25% / 50% / 100%. Will kick off canary deploy at 01:45 and start shifting at 02:00. Quiet window confirmed.
deploy-bot: Deploy kicked: router-v3 -> green pool (deploy-id: dpl-2026-06-01-01). Status: canary started. Logs: 
```
[INFO] canary-provisioning OK
[INFO] healthchecks passing
```
sasha: Quick note — need to pin session affinity for legacy sessions during shift. I can apply sticky cookie on LB: session_affinity=cookie:v3.
mohit: I'll set LB layer weight controls. Command I'll run: 
```
curl -X POST https://lb-api.internal/weights -d '{"service":"router","green":10,"blue":90}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN"
```
ops-oncall: I'll monitor p95 latency, 5xx rate, and request saturation. Alerts: p95 > 250ms or 5xx > 0.5% sustained 5m => rollback. I'll be on pager.
ria: Adding runbook snippet for rollback: to revert, run: 
```
# route weights back to blue
curl -X POST https://lb-api.internal/weights -d '{"service":"router","green":0,"blue":100}'
# then drain green nodes gracefully
kubectl annotate svc/router drain=true --overwrite
```
ken: Suggest adding a short shadow/dry-run: 10% shadow for 10m to watch cache hot paths + tokenization edgecases. Also confirm KV cache warm-up before 25% step.
infra-bot: Preflight checks OK: all health endpoints 200, capacity headroom 30%, rollout quota ok.
sasha: If any circuit-breaker trips, we should abort and flip back to blue immediately. Who will execute rollback? ops-oncall?
ops-oncall: Yes — I'll execute. Callout: if error budget breach occurs, I will flip back and then open an incident.
jordan: Change window approved. Sequence timeline: T+0 (02:00) 10% -> watch 10m; T+12m 25% -> watch 8m; T+25m 50% -> watch 15m; T+40m 100%. Will post updates in thread. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Scheduled tilt plan published to /deployments/router-v3/tilt-2771234000. Automated weight steps: [10,25,50,100] with health gates: p95<250ms && 5xx<0.5%. Will abort on failed gate. :warning:
ken: Linking runbook: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/router-rollbacks. Also note: notify CS briefly in case sticky sessions surface.
ria: I'm attaching quick checklist: load-test probes green nodes, verify DB connection pools per replica, check trace sampling.
ops-oncall: Onstandby at T-5m in this thread. If no issues, confirm green is healthy after 100% and close thread.
jordan: Thanks everyone — starting canary now. Will post per-step confirmations.
